scope: All eight original complete procedures, sixteen historical cases, sixteen conference questions, ten findings and occupied-space reconciliation read. This is not concurrence, acceptance, runtime execution, or an operative change.

records.completeProcedure: Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F; KEEP concentration up to one minute and raising, lowering or redirecting water. NEW select one actually perceived contiguous quantity of liquid water fitting at most a ten-foot cube, with initial line of effect, and record its real quantity/identity/contamination. Actual conjured water may qualify only while its own source permits this physical manipulation; preserve its original quantity, expiry, dispersal/consumption endings, recipient hydration limit and no-sale/no-ingredient restrictions. Manipulation never turns it into permanent natural stock. Fix a twenty-foot-cube working region with its center within sixty feet; all controlled water must remain in that region and within sixty feet of the caster when a new control operation is issued. Water inside a living body, a sealed vessel or a hostile worn/carried container is ineligible; another fluid, ice, steam or unselected incoming water is not silently converted into this inventory. At casting choose one initial operation; each later caster Action can issue one new operation. Each operation displaces the selected water at most ten feet along a declared actually open fluid path to available volume within the region. Choose Raise, Lower or Redirect: Raise lifts a supported connected body’s local surface by at most ten feet above its recorded starting level, maintaining that finite shape while concentration permits; Lower displaces its water sideways/down into actual available volume to lower the local surface at most ten feet below the starting level; Redirect changes its flow along the chosen open path, moving it at most ten feet for that operation. No cumulative height ratchet exceeds those bounds. Existing independent currents keep their actual behavior. There is no unlimited automatic conveyor after a single Action; without a new operation the magic only maintains the currently supported chosen shape. It can hold the selected finite water, not block an entire unselected river or create a vacuum that deletes incoming water. NEW a freely floating body/boat supported by the moved water follows its actual buoyancy and clearance; no weightless lift beyond its existing displacement/support or passage through a real anchor is created. When an operation would displace an unwilling swimming creature, it makes STR against spell DC: failure permits at most ten feet with that operation, success avoids that forced displacement if an actual reachable support/swimming position within its occupied water exists; absent any legal resisting position, the operation cannot force that creature through a barrier and stops at the last legal geometry. A free boat’s actual operating helmsman may instead make a DEX check with one genuinely applicable water-vehicle proficiency against spell DC, Core success/failure, for the whole boat; no fictional helmsman, control channel or repeated passenger saves. A moored/grounded/overloaded boat stays constrained by its real physical support; the spell supplies no breaking force. Each actual creature/boat can face at most one such forced-displacement attempt per Control Water family per round; additional Actions can move other water but cannot replay its forced-motion attempt. Willing following needs no roll. No hydraulic damage, whirlpool attack, automatic drowning, forced submerged airway, swimming speed or breathing benefit is supplied. Actual immersion, temperature, lost support, collisions and breath limits use their real rules and elapsed time. Controlled water keeps quantity and contamination; this is no creation, purification, fish harvest or free Supply. At loss of control, suppression or ending, the water obeys ordinary gravity/current from its actual present location; do not recreate it at its former source. Suppression lifts no fresh shape or missed motion when it ends: another legal Action is required to move/re-form the same remaining eligible water. Escaped water outside the region is no longer controlled; it is not replaced by new inflow. The current Fishing set has completed FI-E01–11 review. Its real stock, one deployment, fifty-five minutes to the check and five retrieval minutes remain; changing water access supplies no automatic catch or replacement roll. A worker spending this spell’s control Action cannot also credit that same six-second interval as active fishing work. Water movement never resets bait, opportunity, preservation or retrieval history.
completeOriginalCases: TU4-05-A: A recorded 200-cubic-foot quantity is redirected ten feet from an open basin into a real adjacent channel with sufficient volume. The basin loses that exact quantity and the channel receives it once. Releasing concentration leaves it in the channel under ordinary flow; neither the basin nor abstract Supply is refilled.

TU4-05-B: An unwilling swimmer in the selected water fails STR and moves ten feet along a legal open path. A second paid control Action that numbered round cannot force another displacement attempt on that same creature. A moored boat in the water does not break its real tether merely because the caster declared Redirect.

records.completeProcedure: Action; range 60 feet; V/S/M/F; Instantaneous. KEEP both actual rank-four Transmutation and Universal placements and genuine raw-material-to-finished-item transformation. NEW one cast resolves one preregistered, otherwise legal MUNDANE manufacturing work order whose entire required production consists of physically shaping/assembling real nonliving raw materials. All reserved consumed/nonconsumed material, maximum possible physical output, packaging and necessary bodies together must fit inside a ten-foot cube and weigh at most 500 pounds. Each participating lot, actual working tool/facility and output position must be perceived within sixty feet and line of effect at resolution, with space/support to receive the actual product. This explicitly replaces all ordinary active shaping/assembly hours of that eligible order with this one casting Action: no hidden requirement to perform the unchanged full hours afterward. Keep exact recipe/formula access, trade-level gate, source-selected ability, actual primary-tool proficiency or permitted untrained disadvantage, real required tools/auxiliaries/station, substitutions, complete material quantities, packaging, component roles and output profile. Fabricate supplies neither an unknown design nor an unavailable tool/facility/material. Its unpriced F alternative never substitutes for the actual substrate. It cannot complete a process requiring magical imbuement/attunement/encoding, creature creation, living growth, fermentation, incubation, chemical preparation or another independently stated natural/calendar wait. A separately specified wholly mundane carrier/body recipe may qualify, but that creates only its ordinary finished body; it does not perform a later Enchanting, Rune Carving, Scribing or magical-device operation. No arbitrary unsourced fraction of a complex recipe’s time is removed. For an eligible order reserve the exact lots at legal cast start; payment/countering precedes its manufacturing resolution. NEW a countered cast releases only those still-existing reserved materials which no actual event consumed, with spell costs still spent and no product/roll/XP. At successful spell resolution, recheck the entire real order and consume/process its exact inputs once, then make one actual recipe creation check and resolve the existing six crafting outcome bands, natural-1 Mishap, yield/structural option, catalyst retention and bounded failure recovery. The spell does not guarantee a successful product or higher equipment grade. A genuine Forge Dwarf quality benefit can apply to its otherwise eligible artisan order; its time multiplier cannot shorten the spell’s one Action. Eligible assistants, if the exact recipe allows them, must actually co-perform this one manufacturing operation with their own Action and tools/position; in initiative they can use ordinary Ready with real Reaction/release, not an invented simultaneous free Action. They provide only the existing +1 each within the actual cap, with no assistant XP. NEW no numerical trade XP is awarded for work replaced by Fabricate, including failure research; record the actual recipe success/quality in the same first-success history, so a later ordinary attempt cannot pretend that recipe was never successfully made. There are no fictitious work hours to satisfy a failure-XP requirement. This explicit learning tradeoff is proposed rather than attributed to the original source. Structural quality, output mass, waste, consumed material, returned catalyst and unused stock must reconcile physically; extra yield cannot duplicate a unique body or exceed material/packaging. A failed batch is not a fresh salvage pool for another cast. This is creation from raw input, not repair, flaw removal, grade improvement, salvage, item recharge or a way to reclassify a used/Broken/enhanced body as never-altered reserve. Finished mundane products persist after the spell; dispel cannot unmanufacture them. Actual permissions, finite buyers, quoted facility reservations and source price-reference rules remain, with no automatic sale, labor-value multiplication or new market.
completeOriginalCases: TU4-06-A: A synthetic admitted mundane recipe has Q4, DC12, forty pounds of real stock and four eight-pound Standard outputs, with adequate packaging and otherwise valid tools/formula. A total of 12 makes four finished units during the one casting Action; eight pounds remain recorded as the actual recipe waste. No ordinary eight-hour work period is fabricated and no trade XP is awarded by this proposal.

TU4-06-B: A source Enchanting order needs an admitted ordinary sword body plus actual magical process inputs and imbuement work. Fabricate cannot finish that magical order. A separate eligible mundane sword recipe can supply a real ordinary sword from its own complete raw materials, after which the actual Enchanting order still needs all of its own inputs, work and source permissions.

records.completeProcedure: KEEP Action,center within60feet,actual60-foot RADIUS and real terrain conversion. NEW choose one of exactly four modes: swamp-to-stone, stone-to-swamp, sand-to-ice, or ice-to-sand. The affected region is the uppermost one vertical foot of exposed ground in a horizontal60-foot-radius disk centered on a perceived ground point; every affected surface requires center line of effect. No sphere,60-foot diameter, deep hidden vein or entire building is inferred. Convert only existing qualifying continuous ordinary nonmagical terrain within that finite region, without importing missing material from outside it. Swamp here is a wet mud/shallow-water ground matrix at least half ordinary mud/soil by volume, not deep open water, living vegetation or an entire wetland ecosystem. Stone means ordinary nonprecious rock terrain, sand ordinary loose mineral sand, ice ordinary frozen water. Exclude creatures, their body volumes, living roots/plants, discrete possessions, built structures/foundations, worked masonry and precious/magical/unique constituents; those remain in place, with the host matrix changed around them only where space permits. Empty air is never filled. Output permanently occupies the same eligible volume; NEW reference bulk masses are stone150lb/cubic foot, swamp matrix70, sand100, ice57. This is an explicit finite material/mass conversion, not a mass-conserving claim. Known different source bulk density is retained in the input record; output uses its named reference. Stone creates ordinary stable ground, swamp/sand are difficult terrain, ice is difficult terrain and requires one DEX save vs original spellDC on a creature's first voluntary entry or regular START there per regular-turn cycle; failure makes it Prone. This ice slip rider is NEW and remains a mundane surface hazard after instantaneous conversion until the surface physically changes, with the recorded originalDC; no entry+START double attempt in one cycle. Normal immunity to Prone applies. Other weather/terrain hazards require their actual separate sources. Hardening excludes each occupied creature/object volume with sufficient existing clearance, so it causes no entrapment, saving throw, automatic crushing or forced relocation. Existing weight-bearing/support consequences remain real, but transformation supplies no immediate arbitrary damage packet or secretly excavated cavity. It may remove/replace a specific former ground-quality hazard only to the extent the real substrate changed; gas, creatures, contamination and weather are not dispelled. Separate pieces/harvested stone/ice remain ordinary permanent output with original lot provenance; later mining/crafting/sale takes actual work and cannot also claim the old swamp/sand. Melted converted ice is real water whose remaining contaminants and actual potable-water qualification must be checked, not automatically purified Supply. This is explicitly a substantial resource-creation/transformation consequence for joint review; no one-lot-at-a-time limit is silently added. Dispel/suppression after the cast does not revert changed terrain or consumed output.
completeOriginalCases: TR5-01-A: An eligible20cubic-foot sand patch inside the full60-foot-radius area becomes20cubic feet of ice. The reference input2000lb becomes1140lb output under the explicit transmutation exception. There is one transformed lot, not both sand and ice; melting it later creates no second parallel stock entry or guaranteed clean-water certificate.

TR5-01-B: Swamp-to-stone affects only the eligible top foot and leaves living roots, creatures and a built bridge untouched. A creature's occupied body is not filled with stone. The spell does not mine the new rock, supply a finished masonry item or let a merchant buy the same old mud and transformed stone separately.

records.completeProcedure: KEEP Action,center60feet,ALL metal creatures/armor pulled to center and STR save. NEW one instantaneous20-foot-radius sphere around a perceived point; affect every eligible creature or armor object with center line of effect, allies included and without seeing every body. A metal creature is one whose actual operative body material is predominantly metal, more than half its body mass; names, ancestry flavor, a carried coin or a nonmetal body's metal weapon do not suffice. An actual armor piece/suit whose principal protective material is metal qualifies independently. A worn/held/carried qualifying armor object attempts to move its whole actual holder/wearer as a single subject, not strip the armor; a body with several qualifying pieces or metal body still rolls/moves once. NEW subjects must be Large or smaller and have total moved weight at most1000lb including all genuine gear/cargo; failed hidden qualification produces no material/weight readout. Each unwilling creature/holder makes STR vs spellDC; willing ones may decline resistance. An unattended eligible armor object cannot roll and is pulled automatically. One failed subject moves up to20feet along the shortest unobstructed straight path toward center, stopping at center or the last whole-body legal position; it need not use Speed and ordinary terrain movement cost does not reduce that distance. Actual solid obstructions, fixed anchors/fastenings and unbreakable tethers stop movement; this spell deals no breaking-force damage or automatic escape through a wall. Resolve nearer subjects first by initial distance to center, then stable identity order, so occupied arrival spaces block later bodies rather than compress them. A legal grapple may end when actual forced separation breaks its reach; an independently absolute anchor remains. No orbit, repeat pulse, ongoing field, concentration, extra round, loss of Action, Prone, general Grappled/Restrained or collision damage is created. Real movement into an independently existing hazard uses that hazard once by its genuine trigger; a creature unsupported after the pull falls normally. Armor is neither detached nor transformed and ownership/inventory remain real. Nonarmor loose metal, embedded medical/body parts not constituting an actual metal body, precious ore in walls and objects outside the sphere are not drawn by a name-based physics extrapolation. Another paid cast is a distinct pulse, never a free persistent tug.
completeOriginalCases: TR5-04-A: An800lb total Large armored creature and a150lb Medium ally in metal armor both lie in the sphere. Each actual unwilling subject makes STR; a failed result moves that whole subject up to20feet toward center, stopping at blockers. Two metal armor pieces on the same ally do not cause two saves or40feet of movement.

TR5-04-B: An unattended metal breastplate is pulled without a save, but a coin purse alone does not qualify its unarmored carrier. A1400lb metal body exceeds the explicit new cap and is not moved. A failed pull against a rigid fixed anchor neither tears off the armor nor manufactures crushing damage.

records.completeProcedure: KEEP Action,60feet,concentration up to60seconds and an actual passage through a wall. NEW choose a perceived wall face and one straight passage perpendicular to it, with an opening up to5feet wide/10feet high and total thickness at most20feet. Eligible wall substance is ordinary nonmagical wood,plaster,earth,brick or nonprecious stone; no metal,magical barrier,precious seam,creature body or independent hidden door/ward override. The chosen whole tunnel must fit within that material and reach a real second open side within20feet. The caster need not already see the exit, but must declare its line/maximum depth; hidden excess thickness/illegal material/embedded creature makes the paid attempt fail without a map or exact hidden-cause report. Intrinsic wall fixtures stay part of the same wall record; independently stored objects/creatures in the proposed solid volume prevent formation rather than being erased. NEW wall substrate is temporarily unavailable within that tunnel and continues to support its existing load around it; no structural-collapse attack or harvestable block is produced. It is a real ordinary opening, allowing ordinary sight,sound,air,liquids,movement and attacks through actual geometry. It is neither a portal nor teleportation; existing hazards and occupants act normally and costs of traversing remain real. Suppression,expiry,concentration loss or eligible removal initiates closure. First resolve occupants/real items in stable identity order: NEW closure can displace them along the original unobstructed tunnel toward the nearest original mouth, at most the original20-foot tunnel length, then to a legal immediately adjacent space at that mouth. Prefer minimum displacement, greatest prior-footprint overlap, then fixed neutral board order; no tactical choice, wall traversal, occupied destination or remote search. This is a narrow explicitly NEW forced-ejection exception to the usual adjacent-only placement rule, not a reusable movement mode, and causes no ordinary OA or spell crushing damage. Whole carried inventories remain with their actual owner; loose items retain separate identities. If neither mouth has a reachable legal adjacent placement, record a local closure placement conflict instead of deleting/crushing/teleporting the occupant. The spell has ended; retain only the minimum occupied clearance and original escape route for resolving that conflict, closed to new entrants and unable to serve as a new through passage, attack aperture, storage expansion, support trick or second cast. A trapped occupant or external helper can use genuine movement/handling along that retained escape route to the nearest legal mouth when it becomes available; restore each vacated section immediately. No fresh rest benefit or guaranteed survival resource is supplied by pending placement. Any actual fluid remaining in the closing volume follows the same nearest-mouth displacement, limited by real available receiving volume; unresolved fluid remains one pending physical volume, not destroyed or duplicated. On suppression the original minute continues; if it lifts before expiry the original same tunnel can reopen only if its formation conditions are still legal, without resetting placement, moving an ended occupant back or duplicating expelled liquid. Original wall mass remains one temporarily affected structure and is restored once, with actual independent wall damage retained.
completeOriginalCases: TR5-06-A: A declared tunnel crosses a12-foot ordinary stone wall and opens to a real empty corridor. Creatures walk through the actual opening using real movement. An unknown25-foot thickness would instead defeat the paid formation; the spell supplies neither a portal nor an exact wall-thickness scan.

TR5-06-B: At closure a creature stands near one mouth. The closest reachable legal adjacent exterior space receives its whole body and carried gear by the bounded ejection. If both mouths are blocked, a recorded local conflict preserves that one body until legal removal; no arbitrary burial damage, duplicate gear or search for a distant safe room is allowed.

records.completeProcedure: KEEP Action,60feet,Instantaneous and both ROCK→MUD and MUD→ROCK. NEW select one perceived exposed region fitting a20-foot cube and at most8000cubic feet, with a chosen mode. The entire eligible connected volume can extend inward up to20feet from the perceived exposed surface; this expressly permits transforming unseen interior matter of that same body, not sensing or selecting an unrelated hidden seam beyond a barrier. Every transformed portion must remain within the chosen cube; its reference center lies within60feet and caster line of effect. Eligible rock is ordinary nonprecious nonmagical natural rock or worked plain stone/mortar; eligible mud is an actual wet soil/ordinary mineral-water mixture, not dry dust,plain water,precious ore,gemstones,metal,living tissue,worn/carried stone items or magical/unique substrate. Choose one direction for the whole cast. Permanently change only that actual eligible material, preserving selected volume and applying NEW reference output masses stone150lb/cubic foot or mud70lb/cubic foot. This expressly changes mass/composition and does not require a separate free-water reagent; the transformed original stock ceases to exist in its old form. Foreign contaminants, precious inclusions, creatures, real possessions and embedded independent objects are excluded and remain themselves. Hardening mud excludes occupied creature/object volumes plus their actual clearance; it grants no save because it does not trap,petrify,crush,displace or attack those bodies. A creature can be left on/within a physically clear depression in the new stone, not sealed inside it; body-space exclusions connect to the existing accessible surface along the shortest original muddy route, with no tunnel through unchanged matter. Softening rock removes its ordinary rigid support. If supported by ground/container, new mud settles there as difficult terrain. If the converted rock was overhead and loses all physical support, NEW one bounded falling-mud burst resolves on creatures directly beneath its actual projected footprint and within20vertical feet: DEX save,4d6bludgeoning on failure or half(floor) on success, one shared roll/one packet per creature per cast; it creates no additional collision packet for the same falling mass. Greater drop distance adds no spell-created damage multiplier. For a creature standing on newly unsupported substrate, ordinary falling instead uses its own real Fall Marker/height; the same person does not receive both this burst and a second invented substrate-impact packet for one event. Mud occupies actual available space and follows physical openings; it does not multiply, tunnel through walls or establish an unbounded damage-per-round field. This proposal grants no automatic drowning, swallowed-body or ongoing Restrained rider; any independently existing water/hazard exposure keeps its own actual profile. The new mud/rock is ordinary real material after resolution; later independent structural collapse caused by a genuinely load-bearing structure losing support uses an actually established structure/hazard profile, not a damage value improvised from unlimited density. If that structure lacks such a profile, establish its explicit finite scenario hazard before committing the spell rather than secretly adding one after payment. The source therefore permits real destruction of qualifying mundane stone support, while its immediate converted-mud burst is fully bounded. Keep actual original structural damage fraction for remaining/converted solid stock: conversion does not repair a damaged crafted structure or create a whole undamaged item profile. Unworked solid stock uses its actual established object profile, or NEWAC15/20structuralHP per contiguous handled lot up to100lb, scaling totalHP linearly by actual mass for a larger homogeneous lot and dividing existing maximum/currentHP proportionally on later splits without duplication. This durability is for stock handling/destruction, not a siege wall strength or free Armor Class for a creature. Liquid mud has no independent targetable rigid-objectHP pool; retain source damage provenance so rehardening cannot refill the former solid stock. Combine with Transmute Terrain only by transforming the actual current substrate/quantity, never recovering old quantities in parallel. Fabricate may later use genuinely qualifying material under its own recipe/tool/time rules; Creation remains an unadopted separate stock-source proposal. Mining work cannot claim a new precious/source-tier yield simply because mud became ordinary stone; excavation/transport/custody/sale remain real. Dispel/suppression after resolution does not revert the instantaneous material or sold/consumed portions.
completeOriginalCases: TR5-08-A: A real10cubic-foot mud lot becomes10cubic feet of ordinary stone: reference mass700→1500lb under the explicit conversion exception. The owner must still excavate/transport the actual1500lb and cannot sell the old700lb mud separately. No gem,source-tier upgrade,perfect brick wall or automatic crafting success is created.

TR5-08-B: An eligible unsupported ceiling section becomes mud and its bounded burst rolls15bludgeoning. An affected creature saving takes7before other defenses, once for that converted falling mass. A different occupied muddy region hardened to stone leaves actual creature clearance rather than petrifying its occupants. Previously damaged solid stock does not return at fullHP merely through mud and back.

records.completeProcedure:
KEEP moving or rotating an actual building/structure up to30feet with Action,range30feet and instantaneous duration. NEW choose one coherent physically connected nonliving structure whose visible qualifying exterior point is within30feet/line of effect. The whole target must fit a40-by40-by30-foot bounding box and have documented/actually established total moved mass no greater than250000lb,including its carried contents and occupants. It may be a complete small building,tower section already structurally independent,bridge span or comparable constructed whole; it is not limited to one loose object. Do not select an inseparable room out of a larger building,slice living roots/bodies or pretend an undefined exceptional fortress has a favorable mass/support profile.

Before casting declare exactly one rigid transformation: horizontal translation of at most30feet,or rotation about one fixed vertical axis through the structure by at most90degrees. Every moved point's actual path length,including rotation arcs,must also be at most30feet. There is no scaling,tilting,inversion,vertical launch or combined translation-plus-rotation in one cast. Full footprint and height must fit the clear swept volume and final legal placement. The caster must perceive the exterior destination/swept envelope well enough to choose it; hidden internal obstruction or ward eligibility resolves after payment,not by a free diagnostic search. It cannot pass through occupied external bodies,other structures,incompatible terrain or a magic boundary that actually prevents this displacement. A merely cosmetic outline is not enough to certify physical placement.

NEW include integral walls,floors,roof,doors and the actual foundation to at most5feet below its current ground contact,all within the overall size/mass bounds. Ordinary gravity anchoring and nonmagical embedded foundation contact do not alone prevent this expressly building-scale move. Actual special magical anchoring does. A part that extends beyond those limits or is structurally inseparable from a larger foundation makes the selected whole ineligible; the spell does not cut it free. Independently connected pipes,cables,chains or structural links must already permit the declared motion through slack/joints or be actually disconnected by a separate lawful procedure. The spell neither severs them for free nor teleports attached off-target networks.

Carry all real contents and creatures actually supported/enclosed by the moving structure in the same rigid transition,including real carried inventories;do not reset their position relative to its floor,HP,conditions or custody. They count toward mass but do not become components of a new creature or sharedHP pool. NEW an unwilling conscious action-capable occupant makes DEX against spellDC before movement. On success it may stay behind only by choosing a genuinely reachable safe open position within5feet of its present place on the structure's exterior edge; this is one explicit forced-transport escape,not an Action/Reaction or teleport through a wall. With no legal such place,success leaves it transported without penalty. Failure/willingness transports it normally,with no automatic damage or Prone. A separate actual immovable-creature/anchor rule that cannot lawfully move prevents that physically conflicting whole transition,not dismemberment.

NEW the spell temporarily supports the moving structure during the instantaneous transition and carries a geometrically matching foundation recess to the destination by displacing only the ordinary loose ground required for that foundation into the vacated original recess. This exchange conserves that actual soil and requires sufficient compatible loose receiving terrain; no excavation of bedrock,valuable ore,buried objects or occupied tunnels is supplied. A structure with no embedded foundation needs no such exchange. Final ordinary support must be real and adequate under its actual structure record or established construction; no lasting magical support remains. Thus the spell cannot finish a house over empty air or unsupported occupants merely to invent a crush/fall attack.

After arrival,ordinary independent damage,hazards,load and changed door/road access apply once at their real causal events. The movement itself deals no building collision damage,creates no automatic collapse and repairs nothing. An actually damaged beam remains damaged;later real failure uses that structure's genuine support/hazard rules. The old site and exchanged ground retain the conserved resulting geometry;no duplicate building,foundation,room contents or new salvage stock exists. No save by the inanimate structure is added,though actual special protection applies. A countered/failed legal cast refunds nothing. After successful completion there is no ongoing displacement magic for dispel to move it back;another move requires another legal paid cast.
completeOriginalCases: TU6-04-A: A complete30-by20-by20-foot timber building and its actual occupants/contents weigh80000lb. Its disconnected fittings,clear swept space and compatible supported destination permit a20-foot horizontal move. The same furniture,people and damaged roof arrive once;neither new loot nor repaired timbers appear. An occupant at a reachable exterior edge may use the proposed successful-DEX5-foot escape.

TU6-04-B: A corner20feet from the chosen rotation axis would travel about31.416feet in a90-degree rotation,exceeding the30-foot point-path limit even though90degrees is the nominal angular maximum. That declared move is ineligible;choose a smaller legal rotation before casting. A destination over an unsupported pit is likewise not a legal way to use the spell for automatic building-scale crushing damage.

records.completeProcedure:
KEEP dramatically reshaping terrain with Action,60feet and instantaneous duration. NEW select one perceived40-foot cube centered within60feet/line of effect and declare one connected terrain change involving at most8000cubic feet of actual eligible substrate inside it. Every moved parcel remains within that cube and travels at most30feet along a physically possible path. The caster declares the final slopes,berms,ramps,trenches or flattened area before resolution;no changing the plan after seeing hidden occupants. This amount can make a substantial20-by20-by20-foot excavation/berm or equivalent conserved geometry rather than merely moving one shovel of dirt.

Eligible material is ordinary loose soil,sand,clay and gravel,including naturally mixed stones no larger than1foot in any dimension. Bedrock,worked masonry,constructed floors,metal,ice,living roots/bodies,valuable separated seams and magical barriers do not become earth by assertion. Embedded roots and independent objects remain actual obstacles/contents:the spell can move surrounding eligible soil but cannot sever,copy,purify,sort or transmute them. Mixed qualifying dirt retains its composition and mass;no ready ore,gem,trade ingredient,food Supply or monetary value is granted merely by moving it. Water is not selected substrate;ordinary flow into the changed terrain remains a separate actual consequence.

Resolve one coherent instantaneous rearrangement,with no sustained invisible excavator or concentration. It may raise/lower land and genuinely change support or access. Preserve actual volume:excavated material must fit a legal destination in the same declared volume,and a raised berm needs the corresponding removed material. Do not compress soil into a denser saleable block,create a vacuum chamber beneath unsupported material or silently destroy surplus. Loose material must have plausible ordinary stable slopes/support under the actual known substrate;it cannot form an unsupported floating slab or permanent vertical sand wall. Existing structure/support records determine genuine later collapse,not a universal invented building damage roll.

Creatures on or in the selected ground are not automatically buried,crushed or incorporated into the moved mass. NEW each unwilling actually displaced ground occupant makes DEX against spellDC once before its affected movement. On success it may choose a genuinely reachable safe open/supporting place within5feet of its current position;no wall passage or tactical remote relocation. If no such place exists,it follows the actual terrain transition without the failure rider. On failure it follows the real supported ground displacement and becomes Prone if that condition can actually apply. Willing occupants may accept that displacement without the Prone rider. Every resulting whole-body placement must avoid overlap;reserve spaces in fixed neutral identity order,not after choosing favored outcomes. The spell grants no additional voluntary movement or attack opportunity.

Where the chosen terrain removes support without carrying the occupant,real falling begins from the actual height under the existing Fall Marker,after the save/escape result. Prone does not itself add damage or force a flying/hovering creature onto the ground;actual unsupported modes follow their own rules. The spell cannot fill an occupied body volume with soil to manufacture suffocation:retain the minimum actual body clearance and include its volume in the conserved geometry. If the declared whole transition cannot preserve all bodies/independent objects and substrate without illegal overlap,that conflicting rearrangement fails as a whole after any hidden eligibility resolution;do not partially generate a favorable berm while deleting the difficult matter. A known impossible plan is rejected before commitment,but unknown buried obstruction is no free map report.

Real disturbed ground can be difficult terrain where its actual final surface qualifies,and a real pit/berm supplies actual cover/height/access. The spell imposes no separate magical slow or enduring damage field. After completion terrain persists as ordinary rearranged matter and obeys rain,load,settling and actual repairs. Dispel does not restore the old hill;another cast must pay again and conserve what exists now. Actual excavation time is replaced only for this selected magical movement,not for surveying,engineering credentials,safe foundation design,harvest identification,refining,crafting or finishing a work order. No extra work Watch,rest credit or free skilled crew follows.
completeOriginalCases: TU6-06-A: The caster moves an actual10-by10-by10-foot block-equivalent of loose earth,1000cubic feet,into a legal nearby berm inside the40-foot cube. The excavation and berm contain the same material. A200-cubic-foot existing cavity cannot receive all1000without another legal receiving volume;the extra800cannot vanish or become compressed commodity stone.

TU6-06-B: An occupant on affected ground fails DEX,rides the actual legal ground displacement and becomes Prone. If the plan instead removes support,it faces real falling from its actual height,not a separate invented6d6spell attack. A concealed immovable object preventing the declared conserved transition can cause paid failure without disclosing a secret tunnel map or deleting that object.

additionalReviewQuestions.question: Original complete text already grants one initial operation during casting. Preserve or explicitly amend that source-local choice rather than treating it as absent. State round history for unscheduled/attached bodies and whether the once-per-family attempt is spent on successful resistance or only displacement. Available fluid volume must exclude actual bodies and include finite displaced water; no partial orphan volume on a blocked operation.
